name: @daimon-os/desktop
description: Daimon-OS desktop shell (Electron) — embeds the Charon gateway + static dashboard.
author: Catalin Tudor

scripts.bundle:gateway: esbuild ../server/src/desktop-entry.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --outfile=src/gateway.mjs --external:node-pty --external:fsevents --banner:js="import { createRequire } from 'module'; const require = createRequire(import.meta.url);" --log-level=info
scripts.bundle:mcp: esbuild ../../packages/mcp/src/index.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --outfile=src/mcp-server.mjs --banner:js="import { createRequire } from 'module'; const require = createRequire(import.meta.url);" --log-level=info
scripts.spike: pnpm build:web && pnpm rebuild:native && pnpm start
scripts.typecheck: echo 'desktop main is plain JS (no typecheck yet)'
